features.name: Find users and display user properties
features.description: A ComboBox lists the machine's users; clicking 'Show properties' enumerates the selected user's properties (name, authentication status, account name, principal name, domain) and displays them in the results text.

features.name: Watch users with a UserWatcher
features.description: Start/Stop buttons control a UserWatcher that enumerates users into a ListBox and reports enumeration/watch status.
expected_behaviour: Scenario reachable from the 'Watch users' navigation item
A 'Start watching' button that begins enumeration and lists users plus a status message
A 'Stop watching' button and a user ListBox are present

features.name: Check user consent group

expected_behaviour: Scenario reachable from the 'Check user consent group' navigation item
A 'Show Consent Group' button that, when clicked, shows the child/minor/adult content consent results
